title: When Safety Checks Become Privacy Risks: A Privacy-Preserving Paradigm for LLM Agent Safety Auditing
title_zh: 当安全检查成为隐私风险：一种面向LLM智能体安全审计的隐私保护范式

paragraphs.en: 提出隐私保护的安全审计范式SealCall，用加密计算分离审计与执行，保护用户敏感信息。 Large language model agents interact with online services through tool calls that may access private data or perform sensitive actions. Specialized providers can supply and maintain pre-execution safety auditing capabilities for agent operators. However, sending task descriptions, call arguments, and interaction histories to an external auditor may expose sensitive user information. In this work, we propose a paradigm for privacy-preserving safety auditing that separates delegated audit computation from plaintext access and execution authority. Grounded in a three-domain auditing model, the paradigm connects trusted representation construction, encrypted audit computation, and trusted decision and execution through explicit interfaces. These interfaces accommodate alternative representations and scorers, while encrypted computation protects audit inputs from a semi-honest auditor. We instantiate this paradigm in SealCall, a framework combining learned audit representations, CKKS-based encrypted similarity computation, and execution control bound to audited tool calls. Evaluated on 1,252 public binary candidates, SealCall achieves a mean F1 score of 0.840 under grouped nested evaluation, while preserving plaintext audit decisions in all measured cases. A representative configuration completes each encrypted scoring operation in 0.176 s.
paragraphs.zh: 提出隐私保护的安全审计范式SealCall，用加密计算分离审计与执行，保护用户敏感信息。大语言模型智能体通过可能访问私人数据或执行敏感操作的工具调用来与在线服务交互。 专业的服务提供商可以为智能体运营方提供并维护执行前安全审计能力。 然而，将任务描述、调用参数和交互历史发送给外部审计方可能会暴露用户的敏感信息。 在本工作中，我们提出了一种隐私保护的安全审计范式，将委托的审计计算与明文访问和执行权限相分离。 该范式基于三域审计模型，通过显式接口连接可信表示构建、加密审计计算以及可信决策与执行。 这些接口支持替换不同的表示和评分器，同时加密计算可保护审计输入不被半诚实审计方获知。 我们在SealCall中将该范式具体化，这是一个结合了学习式审计表示、基于CKKS的加密相似度计算以及绑定到已审计工具调用的执行控制的框架。 在1,252个公开二分类候选样本上的评估表明，SealCall在分组嵌套评估下取得了0.840的平均F1分数，同时在所有测试用例中都保留了明文审计决策。 一个代表性配置可在0.176秒内完成每次加密评分操作。
